WGCNA

Rasmus Rydbirk

2026-04-22

IMPORTANT - This analysis was made almost entirely by MS Copilot. It is experimental and should be interpreted critically. My experience with WGCNA is limited, and due to time constraints I didn’t have time to develop this on my own. The idea was to identify cross-region, region-specific and/or disease-specific modules.

The reference is CTRL FC. I’m not sure that’s the best approach, either a cross-region CTRL reference should be made, or perhaps a more suitable region should be chosen.

Functions

# Light, WGCNA-safe imputation (do not use MinProb here)
median_impute <- function(df) {
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(df))) {
    if (anyNA(df[[j]])) {
      med <- median(df[[j]], na.rm = TRUE)
      df[[j]][is.na(df[[j]])] <- med
    }
  }
  df
}

# WGCNA format helper: samples x genes
to_wgcna_format <- function(expr_mat) {
  t(expr_mat) %>% as.data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
}
build_multiExpr_for_condition <- function(
  df_p, meta, 
  target_condition,
  regions = c("FC","CER","MED","STR","SN"),
  minGenePresentFrac = 0.7,
  minSamplesPerRegion = 6,
  sample_key_col = "id",       # <-- use 'id' (matches colnames(df_p))
  region_col = "condition",    # <-- region factor (FC/CER/MED/STR/SN)
  diagnosis_col = "Diagnosis"  # <-- disease labels (CTRL/PD/MSA/PSP)
) {
  stopifnot(all(c(sample_key_col, region_col, diagnosis_col) %in% names(meta)))

  meta <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      !!diagnosis_col := case_when(
        !!rlang::sym(diagnosis_col) %in% c("CTRL","CTL","Control","CONTROL") ~ "CTRL",
        TRUE ~ as.character(!!rlang::sym(diagnosis_col))
      )
    )

  # Collect samples per region for this condition
  samples_by_region <- lapply(regions, function(r) {
    labs <- meta %>%
      filter(!!rlang::sym(diagnosis_col) == target_condition,
             !!rlang::sym(region_col)    == r) %>%
      pull(!!rlang::sym(sample_key_col)) %>%
      trimws()
    # Intersect with df_p columns (e.g., "CER_1")
    labs <- intersect(labs, colnames(df_p))
    labs
  })
  names(samples_by_region) <- regions

  # Debug counts
  cat("\n[build] Condition =", target_condition, 
      "| samples per region:", 
      paste(names(samples_by_region), sapply(samples_by_region, length), sep=":", collapse="  "), "\n")

  # Keep only regions with enough samples
  expr_by_region <- purrr::imap(samples_by_region, function(labs, r) {
    if (length(labs) < minSamplesPerRegion) return(NULL)
    df_p[, labs, drop = FALSE]  # genes x samples
  })
  expr_by_region <- expr_by_region[!sapply(expr_by_region, is.null)]
  if (length(expr_by_region) < 2)
    stop("Too few regions with enough samples for condition = ", target_condition)

  # Intersect genes across retained regions
  common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(expr_by_region, rownames))
  if (length(common_genes) < 200) {
    warning("Very few common proteins remained (", length(common_genes), 
            "). Consider relaxing filters or minSamplesPerRegion.")
  }

  # Optionally enforce gene presence fraction within each retained region
  keep_genes <- common_genes
  if (!is.null(minGenePresentFrac)) {
    keep_genes <- common_genes[sapply(common_genes, function(g) {
      any(sapply(expr_by_region, function(mat) mean(!is.na(mat[g, ])) >= minGenePresentFrac))
    })]
  }

  expr_by_region <- lapply(expr_by_region, function(mat) mat[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE])

  # WGCNA format: samples x genes, complete, numeric matrices
  multiExpr <- lapply(expr_by_region, function(mat) {
    df <- to_wgcna_format(mat)
    gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(df, verbose = 0)
    if (!gsg$allOK) df <- df[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes, drop = FALSE]
    df <- median_impute(df)
    df <- as.matrix(df); storage.mode(df) <- "double"
    list(data = df)
  })

  multiExpr
}
harmonize_multiExpr_genes <- function(multiExpr, drop_zero_mad = TRUE, mad_min = 1e-8) {
  # 1) Drop bad samples/genes (per set)
  multiExpr <- lapply(multiExpr, function(x) {
    df <- x$data
    gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(df, verbose = 0)
    df  <- df[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes, drop = FALSE]
    x$data <- df
    x
  })
  # 2) Intersect genes across sets
  commonGenes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(multiExpr, function(x) colnames(x$data)))
  if (length(commonGenes) < 200) {
    warning("Very few genes left after intersection: ", length(commonGenes))
  }
  # 3) Optionally drop near-zero MAD columns (stabilize bicor)
  if (drop_zero_mad) {
    keep <- commonGenes
    for (i in seq_along(multiExpr)) {
      df   <- multiExpr[[i]]$data
      mads <- apply(df[, keep, drop = FALSE], 2, mad, na.rm = TRUE)
      keep <- keep[mads[keep] > mad_min]
    }
    commonGenes <- keep
  }
  # 4) Subset to identical columns and impute
  multiExpr <- lapply(multiExpr, function(x) {
    df <- x$data[, commonGenes, drop = FALSE]
    # ensure numeric
    df <- median_impute(as.data.frame(df))
    df <- as.matrix(df); storage.mode(df) <- "double"
    list(data = df)
  })
  # 5) Sanity: identical names/order, numeric, finite
  refCols <- colnames(multiExpr[[1]]$data)
  stopifnot(all(vapply(multiExpr, function(x) identical(colnames(x$data), refCols), logical(1))))
  stopifnot(!any(vapply(multiExpr, function(x) any(!is.finite(x$data)), logical(1))))
  multiExpr
}
pick_power_for_multiset <- function(multiExpr, powers = 1:20, networkType = "signed") {
  sft_list <- lapply(multiExpr, function(x) {
    pickSoftThreshold(x$data, powerVector = powers, networkType = networkType,
                      corFnc = "bicor", verbose = 0)
  })
  df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sft_list), function(i) {
    tibble(
      region = names(multiExpr)[i] %||% paste0("set", i),
      power  = sft_list[[i]]$fitIndices[, "Power"],
      R2     = sft_list[[i]]$fitIndices[, "SFT.R.sq"]
    )
  }))
  power_candidates <- df %>%
    group_by(power) %>%
    summarise(medianR2 = median(R2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(power)
  chosen <- with(power_candidates, if (any(medianR2 >= 0.8)) min(power[medianR2 >= 0.8]) else 8)
  list(chosenPower = chosen, sft = sft_list, summary = power_candidates)
}
align_to_reference <- function(multiExpr, refGenes, minSamplesPerRegion = 4) {
  out <- lapply(multiExpr, function(x) {
    dat <- x$data
    keep <- intersect(colnames(dat), refGenes)
    dat  <- dat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
    # reorder to ref order for the overlapping genes
    dat  <- dat[, refGenes[refGenes %in% keep], drop = FALSE]
    # make sure numeric and complete
    dat <- as.data.frame(dat)
    dat <- median_impute(dat)
    dat <- as.matrix(dat); storage.mode(dat) <- "double"
    list(data = dat)
  })
  # drop regions with too few samples
  out <- out[!vapply(out, function(s) nrow(s$data) < minSamplesPerRegion, logical(1))]
  out
}

flatten_multi_set <- function(multiExpr, prefix) {
  out <- multiExpr
  names(out) <- paste0(prefix, "_", names(multiExpr))
  out
}
# Harmonize ALL sets (CTRL + disease) to the same genes in the same order
harmonize_multiExpr_all_sets <- function(multiExpr_all, drop_zero_mad = TRUE, mad_min = 1e-6) {
  # 1) Drop obviously bad samples/genes per set
  multiExpr_all <- lapply(multiExpr_all, function(x) {
    df <- x$data
    gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(df, verbose = 0)
    df  <- df[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes, drop = FALSE]
    x$data <- df
    x
  })
  # 2) Global common gene set across ALL sets
  commonGenes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(multiExpr_all, function(x) colnames(x$data)))
  if (length(commonGenes) < 200) {
    warning("Very few common genes across all sets: ", length(commonGenes))
  }
  # 3) Optionally drop near-zero MAD genes across ALL sets - EXCLUDED, ALREADY PERFORMED
  # if (drop_zero_mad) {
  #   keep <- commonGenes
  #   for (i in seq_along(multiExpr_all)) {
  #     df   <- multiExpr_all[[i]]$data
  #     mads <- apply(df[, keep, drop = FALSE], 2, mad, na.rm = TRUE)
  #     keep <- keep[mads[keep] > mad_min]
  #   }
  #   commonGenes <- keep
  # }
  # 4) Subset, reorder, impute, coerce to double matrices
  multiExpr_all <- lapply(multiExpr_all, function(x) {
    df <- x$data[, commonGenes, drop = FALSE]
    df <- median_impute(as.data.frame(df))
    df <- as.matrix(df); storage.mode(df) <- "double"
    list(data = df)
  })
  # 5) Sanity checks
  refCols <- colnames(multiExpr_all[[1]]$data)
  stopifnot(all(vapply(multiExpr_all, function(z) identical(colnames(z$data), refCols), logical(1))))
  stopifnot(!any(vapply(multiExpr_all, function(z) any(!is.finite(z$data)), logical(1))))
  multiExpr_all
}
# ---- Robust preservation results extractor ----
get_preservation_results <- function(mp, multiExpr_all, refSetIndex) {
  refName <- names(multiExpr_all)[refSetIndex]
  refKey  <- paste0("ref.", refName)

  # Z component: must be nested by ref name, as shown by your object
  Zref <- mp$preservation$Z[[refKey]]
  if (is.null(Zref)) {
    stop("Could not find Z component under ", refKey,
         ". Available names: ", paste(names(mp$preservation$Z), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # observed component: try the same nesting first; if absent, fall back to flat list
  ObsRef_try <- mp$preservation$observed[[refKey]]
  is_nested_observed <- !is.null(ObsRef_try)

  # Helper: pick an available Zsummary column name
  pick_z_col <- function(dfZ) {
    candidates <- c("Zsummary.combined", "Zsummary.pres", "Zsummary")
    hit <- intersect(candidates, colnames(dfZ))
    if (length(hit) == 0) {
      stop("None of expected Zsummary columns present in Z table.\n",
           "Have: ", paste(colnames(dfZ), collapse = ", "))
    }
    hit[1]
  }

  # Build tidy rows for each non-reference set
  out <- lapply(seq_along(multiExpr_all), function(iSet) {
    if (iSet == refSetIndex) return(NULL)

    testName <- names(multiExpr_all)[iSet]
    Zname    <- paste0("inColumnsAlsoPresentIn.", testName)

    # Z table for this test set
    statsZ <- Zref[[Zname]]
    if (is.null(statsZ)) {
      stop("Z table not found for test set '", testName, "'. ",
           "Available Z names: ", paste(names(Zref), collapse = ", "))
    }

    # Observed table for this test set
    if (is_nested_observed) {
      statsObs <- ObsRef_try[[Zname]]
      if (is.null(statsObs)) {
        stop("Observed table (nested) not found for test set '", testName, "'. ",
             "Available observed names: ",
             paste(names(ObsRef_try), collapse = ", "))
      }
    } else {
      # Flat observed list has length (nSets - 1) and skips the reference.
      # Map iSet (1..nSets, skipping ref) → obsIndex (1..nSets-1)
      obsIndex <- if (iSet < refSetIndex) iSet else iSet - 1
      statsObs <- mp$preservation$observed[[obsIndex]]
      if (is.null(statsObs)) {
        stop("Observed table (flat) out of bounds at index ", obsIndex,
             ". Length(observed) = ", length(mp$preservation$observed))
      }
    }

    z_col <- pick_z_col(statsZ)

    tibble::tibble(
      testSet    = testName,
      module     = rownames(statsZ),
      moduleSize = statsZ[, "moduleSize"],
      Zsummary   = statsZ[, z_col],
      medianRank = statsObs[, "medianRank.pres"]
    )
  })

  dplyr::bind_rows(out) %>% dplyr::filter(module != "gold")
}

Calculate

regions    <- c("FC","CER","MED","STR","SN")
conditions <- intersect(c("CTRL","PD","MSA","PSP"),
                        unique(meta$Diagnosis))

# Build multiExpr per condition (key = 'id')
multiExpr_list <- lapply(conditions, function(cond) {
  build_multiExpr_for_condition(
    df_p, meta,
    target_condition   = cond,
    regions            = regions,
    minGenePresentFrac = 0.7,
    minSamplesPerRegion= 6,
    sample_key_col     = "id",          # <-- important
    region_col         = "condition",
    diagnosis_col      = "Diagnosis"
  )
})

## 
## [build] Condition = PSP | samples per region: FC:9  CER:7  MED:8  STR:11  SN:11
names(multiExpr_list) <- conditions

# Choose reference condition (CTRL if present)
ref_condition <- if ("CTRL" %in% names(multiExpr_list)) "CTRL" else names(multiExpr_list)[1]

# Harmonize CTRL sets and pick power
multiExpr_ref <- harmonize_multiExpr_genes(
  multiExpr_list[[ref_condition]], drop_zero_mad = TRUE, mad_min = 1e-6
)

pw <- pick_power_for_multiset(multiExpr_ref, powers = 1:20, networkType = "signed")

  mutate(

  )

# 1) Get module gene lists (using the consensus colors and the reference gene vector)
gene_symbols <- colnames(multiExpr_ref[[1]]$data)  # CTRL consensus gene space (pre-global-harmonization)
modules_tbl <- tibble(
  gene   = gene_symbols,
  module = consensusColors_CTRL
) %>% filter(module != "grey")

mods <- split(modules_tbl$gene, modules_tbl$module)

# 2) Map symbols to ENTREZ for enrichment
sym2ent <- bitr(unique(modules_tbl$gene), fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
## 'select()' returned 1:1 mapping between keys and columns
## Warning in bitr(unique(modules_tbl$gene), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType =
## "ENTREZID", : 0.08% of input gene IDs are fail to map...
mods_ent <- lapply(mods, function(genes) {
  unique(na.omit(sym2ent$ENTREZID[match(genes, sym2ent$SYMBOL)]))
})

# 3) Enrichment per module (GO BP + Reactome)
enrich_list_GO <- lapply(names(mods_ent), function(m) {
  ego <- tryCatch(
    enrichGO(gene = mods_ent[[m]], OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
             ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", readable = TRUE,
             minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 2000, qvalueCutoff = 0.05),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
    res <- as.data.frame(ego) %>% mutate(module = m, source = "GO:BP")
  } else {
    res <- tibble()
  }
  res
})
enrich_list_Reactome <- lapply(names(mods_ent), function(m) {
  er <- tryCatch(
    enrichPathway(gene = mods_ent[[m]], organism = "human", pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                  qvalueCutoff = 0.05, readable = TRUE, minGSSize = 10),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(er) && nrow(as.data.frame(er)) > 0) {
    res <- as.data.frame(er) %>% mutate(module = m, source = "Reactome")
  } else {
    res <- tibble()
  }
  res
})

enrich_tbl <- bind_rows(enrich_list_GO, enrich_list_Reactome) %>%
  dplyr::select(module, source, ID, Description, GeneRatio, BgRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, qvalue, Count)

# Compute ME per set
ME_list <- lapply(multiExpr_all, function(s) {
  dat <- s$data
  # If some modules have too few genes post-harmonization, WGCNA handles it but may drop MEs.
  MEs <- moduleEigengenes(dat, colors = moduleColors_ref, excludeGrey = TRUE)$eigengenes
  # Ensure consistent ME ordering by the same module factor levels:
  MEs
})

# Build a tidy summary: mean ME per module per set
ME_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(ME_list), function(i) {
  if (is.null(ME_list[[i]]) || ncol(ME_list[[i]]) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(ME_list[[i]], check.names = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(sample = rownames(multiExpr_all[[i]]$data)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("ME"), names_to = "ME", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(ME) %>%
    summarise(meanME = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(set = names(multiExpr_all)[i])
}))

# Separate condition and region for readability (expects names like PD_SN)
ME_summary <- ME_summary %>%
  tidyr::separate(set, into = c("condition","region"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)

# Compute deltas vs CTRL per region for each module
ctrl_means <- ME_summary %>%
  filter(condition == "CTRL") %>%
  dplyr::select(ME, region, meanME) %>%
  rename(meanME_CTRL = meanME)

ME_deltas <- ME_summary %>%
  left_join(ctrl_means, by = c("ME","region")) %>%
  filter(condition != "CTRL") %>%
  mutate(deltaME = meanME - meanME_CTRL)

# Heatmap of deltaME (disease minus CTRL, per region)

       aes(x = paste(condition, region, sep = "_"), y = ME, fill = deltaME)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575b4", mid = "white", high = "#d73027",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "ΔME vs CTRL") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Module eigengene differences vs region-matched CTRL",
       x = "Test set", y = "Module eigengene")

  colors <- consensusColors_CTRL[match(common_genes, ctrl_genes)]

  moduleEigengenes(
    dat,
    colors = colors,
    excludeGrey = TRUE
  )$eigengenes
})

      names_to = "ME",
      values_to = "harmonized_ME"
    ) %>%
    group_by(ME) %>%
    summarise(
      harmonized_ME = mean(harmonized_ME, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(set = names(multiExpr_all)[i])
}))

ME_projected_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(ME_projected), function(i) {
  if (is.null(ME_projected[[i]]) || ncol(ME_projected[[i]]) == 0) return(NULL)

  as.data.frame(ME_projected[[i]], check.names = FALSE) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = "ME",
      values_to = "projected_ME"
    ) %>%
    group_by(ME) %>%
    summarise(
      projected_ME = mean(projected_ME, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(set = names(multiExpr_all)[i])
}))

compare_df <- inner_join(
  ME_harmonized_summary,
  ME_projected_summary,
  by = c("set", "ME")
)

head(compare_df)

##       Min.    1st Qu.     Median       Mean    3rd Qu.       Max.

# Points near diagonal
# → Harmonization did not distort module interpretation
# 
# 
# Systematic vertical shift
# → Biological signal preserved, scale differs
# 
# 
# Wide scatter / flat projected ME
# → Harmonization removed informative genes
# → Prefer projected ME for biology
# 
# 
# Module‑specific failure
# → Often matches modules flagged by your module size stability check

ggplot(compare_df, aes(harmonized_ME, projected_ME)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ ME, scales = "free") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Harmonized vs projected module eigengenes")

# Interpretation
# 
# Shift toward 0 → module disintegrated
# Similar distributions → module preserved biologically

gene2module <- tibble(
  gene   = names(consensusColors_CTRL),
  module = consensusColors_CTRL
) %>%
  filter(module != "grey")

kme_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(multiExpr_all), function(i) {

  dat <- multiExpr_all[[i]]$data
  MEs <- ME_projected[[i]]

  if (is.null(MEs) || is.null(dat)) return(NULL)

  set_name <- names(multiExpr_all)[i]

  # Parse condition from set name (expects CONDITION_REGION)
  condition <- sub("_.*$", "", set_name)

  # Restrict to shared genes
  common_genes <- intersect(colnames(dat), gene2module$gene)
  dat <- dat[, common_genes, drop = FALSE]

  gene_module_sub <- gene2module %>%
    filter(gene %in% common_genes)

  bind_rows(lapply(unique(gene_module_sub$module), function(mod) {

    genes_mod <- gene_module_sub$gene[gene_module_sub$module == mod]
    ME_name   <- paste0("ME", mod)

    if (!ME_name %in% colnames(MEs)) return(NULL)

    me_vec <- MEs[, ME_name]

    tibble(
      gene = genes_mod,
      module = mod,
      correlation = apply(dat[, genes_mod, drop = FALSE], 2, function(g)
        cor(g, me_vec, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      ),
      set = set_name,
      condition = condition
    )
  }))
}))

summary(kme_df$correlation)
##    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
## -0.9792  0.1520  0.6587  0.4403  0.8508  0.9983
table(is.na(kme_df$correlation))
## 
## FALSE 
## 22122
# CTRL distributions centered away from 0
# → strong module coherence (expected)
# 
# 
# Disease distributions flattened or shifted toward 0
# → module structure disrupted
# 
# 
# Module‑specific collapse
# → matches low Zsummary or size‑unstable modules
# 
# 
# This plot is biologically complementary to:
# 
# module preservation Zsummary
# eigengene Δ plots

ggplot(kme_df, aes(correlation, fill = condition)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ module, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gene–module coherence using projected CTRL MEs")

ME_proj_long <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(ME_projected), function(i) {

  MEs <- ME_projected[[i]]
  if (is.null(MEs) || ncol(MEs) == 0) return(NULL)

  set_name <- names(multiExpr_all)[i]

  as.data.frame(MEs, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(sample = rownames(MEs)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -sample,
      names_to = "ME",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(set = set_name)
}))

ME_proj_long <- ME_proj_long %>%
  tidyr::separate(
    set,
    into = c("condition", "region"),
    sep = "_",
    remove = FALSE
  )

stopifnot(all(c("sample","ME","value","condition","region") %in% colnames(ME_proj_long)))
summary(ME_proj_long$value)
##      Min.   1st Qu.    Median      Mean   3rd Qu.      Max. 
## -0.906952 -0.239021  0.008761  0.000000  0.233882  0.805255
# CTRL violins centered near 0 → expected (signed MEs)
# Shifted disease violins → altered module activity
# Wider violins → increased heterogeneity
# Module‑specific patterns → supports biological specificity

ggplot(ME_proj_long,
       aes(x = condition, y = value, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ ME, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Projected CTRL module eigengenes across conditions",
       y = "Projected ME")
